articles.title: Mid-Year Sale is Here!
articles.description: To thank our valued customers, we are holding a grand mid-year promotion from April 16 to April 22, 2026. Enjoy up to 3% off on select products!
articles.content:
Mid-Year Sale

Promotion Period: April 16, 2026 08:00:00 to April 22, 2026 08:00:00 (UTC)

During the sale, enjoy up to 3% off on select products! Popular items available for limited-time flash deals. Stack coupons for extra savings!

Rules:

  1. Orders placed during the promotion period are eligible
  2. Limited stock - first come, first served
  3. Store coupons can be combined with platform coupons
  4. Final interpretation belongs to the company

Shop now before it's gone!
